sections.content:
Job Title: Video Editor - EmpireDrop
Salary: Competitive Salary + Performance-Based Bonuses

sections.heading: Description:
sections.content: As a Video Editor, you will be responsible for creating and editing high-quality video content for our platform. Your role will be crucial in producing engaging clips, YouTube videos, and other visual content that connects with our audience. This isn’t just about technical editing skills—it’s about bringing creativity and consistency to each project, helping EmpireDrop maintain its visual identity and engage viewers.

sections.heading: Responsibilities:
sections.content:
Daily Clip Editing: Quickly and efficiently edit daily clips for social media and other platforms.
YouTube Video Creation: Create full-length, engaging videos for our YouTube channel, adding intros, transitions, and effects (FX) as needed.
Enhancing Visuals with FX: Use effects to elevate videos, ensuring a professional and visually appealing result.
Collaboration: Work closely with our creative team to understand project requirements and align with the brand’s vision.
File Management: Organize and manage video assets, ensuring efficient access and storage for ongoing projects.

sections.heading: Required Skills:
sections.content:
Proven Experience in Video Editing: At least 2 years of professional experience in video editing with a strong portfolio.
Advanced Technical Skills: Proficiency in video editing software (such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro) and a solid understanding of FX.
High Availability: Must be available daily for quick edits and larger projects, with a strong commitment to fast turnaround times.
Creativity & Attention to Detail: Ability to tell a story visually, focus on quality, and deliver polished, cohesive content.
Strong Communication: Ability to understand project briefs and collaborate effectively with the team.

sections.heading: Conditions:
sections.content:
Part-Time Contract: Flexibility for daily tasks and quick turnarounds.
Competitive Salary with Bonuses: Compensation includes performance-based incentives based on the quality and impact of delivered content.

sections.heading: About Us:
sections.content: EmpireDrop is a fast-growing online platform known for delivering exciting and engaging experiences in the mystery box and gaming space. We’re committed to offering our users high-quality content that keeps them connected to our brand. As we expand our reach, we’re looking for a talented Video Editor to bring creative ideas, attention to detail, and a professional touch to our video production. If you’re passionate about crafting impactful content and enjoy the thrill of a fast-paced environment, EmpireDrop could be the perfect place for you.

sections.heading: Why Join EmpireDrop?
sections.content: At EmpireDrop, we value dedication, creativity, and the ability to deliver under pressure. We’re building something unique, and we need key contributors who are ready to bring fresh ideas and high energy every day. If you're a high performer looking to make an impact, we offer a rewarding environment with room for growth.

sections.heading: How to Apply:
sections.content: If you’re ready to take on this exciting role, please send us your resume along with a portfolio showcasing your video editing skills, including clips with effects (FX). We’d also love to hear about your favorite editing projects and what you would bring to EmpireDrop’s creative team.
